What you should know about hair-stroke eyebrow tattooing

Let’s take a closer look at this method.

Hair-stroke eyebrow permanent makeup techniques

There are two types: Eastern and European. The European technique involves drawing hair strokes of the same length and thickness, following the direction of growth. This option is used less often, but it is recommended when only part of the brow arch needs to be reshaped. The Eastern technique, by contrast, involves drawing strokes of different lengths, thicknesses and growth directions, and even in different shades. This makes the brows look more natural and effortless. It is used when the brows need to be reshaped completely.

Benefits of the hair-stroke technique

If your brows are sparse or very light and you don’t want to fill them in all the time, choose the hair-stroke technique. It will:

  • make the shape look brighter and more expressive. The arch will look great and be neatly defined, and the brows will have a natural shade without looking overdone;
  • hide imperfections. Scars, for example, will visually disappear completely. This technique may be the best option when certain flaws need to be concealed;
  • make you feel confident. You will no longer need to tint your brows, carry a makeup bag or do your makeup every morning.

Your brows will always look beautiful after the beach, the pool or a bath.
It is worth stressing that this technique is rarely used on its own. Most often it is combined with powder brows micropigmentation. This way, you can achieve the most natural look possible.

Stages of the hair-stroke eyebrow micropigmentation procedure

Hair-stroke eyebrow permanent makeup starts with choosing the pigment, after which the sketch is drawn. This is an important step: the experienced artist draws each hair stroke, creating an even brow design. You need to see how your brows will look in the end and decide whether the design suits you. Next, the artist performs the tattoo. At first, no anesthetic is used. It isn’t needed, since the skin is not yet injured and the first stage is painless. An additional anesthetic is then applied, and the process is repeated until the desired effect is achieved. At the end of the session, the artist will give you aftercare advice and book your touch-up appointment.

A touch-up is a must!

If you want the result to last longer, don’t skip the touch-up after your hair-stroke eyebrow tattoo. It enriches the strokes with color and, if needed, lets the artist redraw areas where the strokes have lost their shape or color. It is best to have the touch-up 28–30 days after your first session. By then, the skin is considered fully regenerated and ready for pigment again.

How long it lasts

How long a hair-stroke tattoo lasts varies from person to person – on average, 1.5–2 years. The key factors are skin type, age and lifestyle. People with oily skin should have touch-ups more often, as the effect may start to fade as early as 6–8 months after the touch-up. In older people or those with dry skin, the effect lasts longer.

Contraindications

The main contraindications for the hair-stroke technique include insulin-dependent diabetes, HIV, AIDS, epilepsy, skin inflammation in the brow area, pregnancy and breastfeeding. The procedure is not recommended if you are feeling unwell or have a viral illness, a high temperature or high blood pressure. Your period is not a contraindication.

Have you decided to get a hair-stroke eyebrow tattoo?

Wonderful! The artists at our LBar studio in Bucharest will be happy to help. We guarantee a procedure that is completely safe in every possible way: we use only single-use disposables, high-quality pigments, professional equipment and triple sterilization of reusable tools. Sparse brows, or brows that are partly or completely missing, are no longer a problem. Simply choose affordable hair-stroke eyebrow tattooing and enjoy your newfound confidence.

tvs.text_bl1_about: Hair-stroke eyebrow pigmentation is a simple way to restore the shape and density of your brows. It is an ideal technique for sparse hairs, chaotic and uneven growth, or hair loss caused by illness. The main difference between microblading and other techniques is that it fully imitates the growth of natural brows. The result looks quite natural, the brow shape is correct, and the density is exactly what you need. You no longer have to worry about missing hairs in your brow area. The hair-stroke technique will restore volume quickly and safely.

migx_questions.questions-title: What makes the hair-stroke eyebrow tattoo technique special?
migx_questions.questions-text: What sets the hair-stroke technique apart is that each hair stroke can be drawn by hand, creating volume, width and length to suit your preferences and features.
No. The procedure is painless thanks to an anesthetic that reduces not only pain but also redness and skin inflammation.

migx_questions.questions-title: What is the difference between hair-stroke brows and microblading?
migx_questions.questions-text: In terms of the final result, the techniques are identical. The only difference is the equipment used during the procedure. Microblading uses a manual tool – a small pen fitted with a microblade that makes an incision in the skin, into which the pigment is placed. In hair-stroke tattooing, the strokes are drawn with a classic semi-permanent makeup machine. The hair-stroke technique is safer and more reliable than microblading.

migx_questions.questions-title: Can I have hair-stroke eyebrow micropigmentation during pregnancy?
migx_questions.questions-text: No. Hair-stroke eyebrow micropigmentation is contraindicated during pregnancy and breastfeeding, because an anesthetic has to be applied during the procedure.
